scenes.heading: Evaluating whether a trading course or signal service is worth it

sents.d: Evaluating whether a trading course or signal service is worth it
A healthy skepticism protects against a common source of losses.

scenes.heading: Useful or built to profit from you

sents.d: The trading education space includes both genuinely useful resources and services designed primarily to profit from beginners, and it can be difficult to tell the difference from marketing alone.

Red flags worth taking seriously include guaranteed returns, pressure to decide quickly, results shown without verifiable track records, and a heavier focus on recruiting other members than on the actual trading content.

Asking to see a genuinely verifiable track record, checking independent reviews outside the platform itself, and being wary of any service that discourages questions are reasonable steps before spending money on trading education or signals.

take: Demand a verifiable track record before paying for trading education.
